entries:
Alpha 1.9.24 (a grander Lanternhold Casino)

  • Two full gaming floors: Explore equally spacious public and VIP halls. Stairs switch floors completely, with no upstairs patrons, furniture or effects visible from downstairs. Each floor has 4 blackjack tables, 4 Hold’em tables, 2 roulette tables, 4 baccarat tables and 32 themed slot machines.
  • Roulette and baccarat: Join shared, timed rounds with persistent seats and a dealer, one-click wagers, optional multi-bet slips, animated reveals and clear saved winnings. Change your stake between rounds. Single-zero roulette supports inside and outside bets; baccarat follows standard drawing rules with 5% Banker commission.
  • Keep your winnings: Confirmed wagers and payouts recover after disconnects and server restarts. Public games use Gold; VIP games use EP. Limits remain 100,000 Gold or 100 EP per round, with no EP-to-Gold conversion or gameplay-power rewards.
  • Automatic administrator VIP: Administrators receive VIP access and 100 EP monthly. Durable receipts prevent repeat grants or stacking the same month's normal VIP allowance. No payment integration has been added.
  • Dependable administration history: Requests deferred by character, trading, casino or operation-storage recovery now retain a sanitized audit entry, without duplicating grants when the same request is retried.
  • A clearer town entrance: The stash sits west toward the Trading House, clear of the casino door. The entrance is labeled Lanternhold Casino and retains its clickable entry dialogue.
  • Integration continues: Remaining campaign and group-raid checks are still in progress. This release is not full 1.10 sign-off.

Alpha 1.9.23 (history that survives an outage)

  • More dependable administration history: Rejected malformed requests, conflicting request IDs and failed role lookups now retain their audit entries in the durable activity journal when the database is unavailable. The original entries are restored when storage recovers, including after a server restart.
  • Still fail closed: Rejected requests grant nothing. Permissions, item and Gold rules, and successful-operation replay protection are unchanged. If both storage paths fail, the panel still reports that activity storage is unavailable.
  • Integration continues: The remaining earned campaign and group-raid checks remain in progress. This maintenance patch is not full 1.10 sign-off.

Alpha 1.9.22 (keep your party in sight)

  • Four-player party visibility: Full dungeon parties now use a compact two-column roster. All four health bars and the party heading stay visible while ready checks, loot settings and invitations scroll separately.
  • Keep control: Healing selection and leader actions remain available. Smaller parties, larger raid layouts and phone controls are unchanged.
  • Campaign progress: The earned Wizard route through Verdant now passes with a four-player party, manual rewards and saved Water handoff. Remaining realms, raids and final 1.10 checks are still in progress; this is not full campaign sign-off.

Alpha 1.9.21 (the whole raid in view)

  • Every health bar counts: Desktop parties with five or more members now use a compact two-column raid roster. At the standard 1280×720 layout, all ten health bars fit above chat without scrolling, including both healers in a five-player group.
  • Healing stays within reach: Healing-target selection and its clear button remain available alongside raid roles, readiness and leader controls. Four-player parties and phone controls are unchanged.
  • Less deployment waiting: Independent hosted checks now run alongside each other, with browser work distributed more evenly. All release gates and test coverage remain in place.
  • Final integration continues: The full 1.10 campaign, group-raid and physical-phone checks remain in progress.

Alpha 1.9.20 (the crystal holds its ground)

  • Repair the crystal, not the boss's last position: Crystal repair events now stay centered on the crystal chamber in all four elemental raids. Defeating a guardian near a wall no longer shifts Maelin, ritual markers and surrounding enemy waves away from the crystal or outside the arena.
  • The same challenge: Three repair waves, each realm's ritual tasks, enemy strength, rewards and manual quest turn-ins are unchanged. The 15-minute dungeon logout rule is unchanged.
  • Final integration continues: The full 1.10 campaign, group-raid and physical-phone checks remain in progress.

Alpha 1.9.19 (a place for every patron)

  • No floating upstairs patrons: Casino players on the VIP balcony now follow its cutaway when you walk beneath it, instead of appearing to float over downstairs tables. Bringing the balcony back into view restores its patrons, while the public gaming floor remains populated when viewed from upstairs.
  • Clear clicks downstairs: Patrons on a hidden upper floor no longer intercept pointer selection, and their Well Rested auras and other attached effects follow the same cutaway without cancelling buffs. Table seating, cameras, wagers, Gold/EP rules and VIP access are unchanged.
  • Continuing the final polish: The full 1.10 campaign, group-raid and physical-phone checks remain in progress.

Alpha 1.9.18 (stone beneath the spelllight)

  • Readable dungeon stone: Corrected texture color encoding restores the intended stone colors and visible masonry across the five dungeon themes and their elemental raid interiors.
  • Calmer ground underfoot: Larger floor patterns, smoother texture filtering and subdued decorative glow leave more visual space for characters and combat cues. Water floors lose the repeating bright pearl speckles; their luminous wall details remain.
  • The same encounters: Room geometry, collisions, enemy strength, rewards and crystal-repair mechanics are unchanged. The full 1.10 campaign and group-raid verification remains in progress.

Alpha 1.9.17 (the wardens have a desk)

  • Administrator operations are now in-game: Accounts with a verified durable administrator role can open Administration from the game menu, browse online players and inspect bounded login, resume, disconnect and action history. Ordinary accounts and release-QA access do not unlock these controls.
  • Deliberate, recorded changes: Create canonical equipment or materials, grant bounded Gold, teleport yourself to a player, bring a player to you, or send a character to town. Every operation requires a review, explicit confirmation and a reason, with fresh server authorization and a saved audit.
  • Retries do not duplicate rewards: Interrupted saves and audits recover automatically. Retrying the same request preserves its original items and outcome without granting again or moving a character twice. The panel keeps uncertain requests available for a same-request retry after reconnecting.
  • Clear landings and consistent scenes: Teleports check actual town and realm collision geometry, occupied positions and canonical dungeon floors. Private-instance and VIP entry restrictions remain in place; scene changes preserve authoritative floor height.
  • Normal play is unchanged: No changes to combat rewards, EP conversion, VIP benefits or the 15-minute dungeon logout rule. Administrator actions do not refill resources or reset cooldowns. The complete 1.10 roadmap remains in progress.

Alpha 1.9.16 (hit like a landslide)

  • Charge lands twice as hard: The Fighter's base right-click Charge now deals double its previous impact damage in multiplayer and offline play.
  • The rest of the kit keeps its identity: Momentum still scales from the stronger base hit, while Shattering Charge, Juggernaut Charge, Shockwave knockback, range, cooldown, and mana cost are unchanged.

Alpha 1.9.15 (trusted hands)

  • Administration has a safe foundation: Approved accounts can now activate a durable administrator role without changing character level, equipment, or progression.
  • Authority stays server-owned: Administrator status follows the authenticated account, remains separate from release-QA access, and is persisted before success is reported.
